environment: claude-code cloud container (Linux x86_64, Python 3.13, Node 22)
method: pip into /opt/sectools-venv (symlinked to /usr/local/bin) for Python tools; pinned GitHub release binaries for Go tools
note: This records REAL install state in this container. The running platform re-derives each tool's state live via shutil.which + --version at readiness time; this file is a point-in-time snapshot.

trivy.reason: GitHub release assets return HTTP 404 through this container's egress proxy and the Trivy installer cannot reach api.github.com for the latest tag. Connector is implemented; tool binary is not installable in this environment. OSV-Scanner + pip-audit cover the dependency category per spec ("Trivy or OSV-Scanner").
